entities.summary: Serovpe (Servitchen) Vitchenian was a prominent Ottoman Armenian physician, educator, journalist, writer, and politician. He was the founder of the first Ottoman medical journal. He was also a key figure in the promulgation of the Armenian National Constitution in 1863.
